title: Charcoal Automation
description: &6Wood&r obtained from a tree farm can be smelted or processed in a &3Combination Oven&r to produce &6Charcoal&r, which has many uses, such as fuel for &3Furnaces&r or even the &3Blast Furnace&r, &6Flux&r or &6Carbon&r in a Crucible for &6Steel&r production, or even &6Gunpowder&r for ammunition.
